name: external-service-workflow-agent
description: Example workflow agent that uses external services through stable workflow commands while keeping implementation details in commands and settings.
mission: Read user-editable non-secret settings from settings.json.
Run ordered workflow commands from workflow/.
Use utilities/ for diagnostics and support tasks.
Preserve local evidence without committing processed files.

externalTools.name: curl
externalTools.purpose: HTTP client used by command implementations.

externalTools.name: node
externalTools.purpose: Read JSON settings and normalize command output.

internalTools.name: fetch-item
internalTools.purpose: Step 1: Fetch one item from the configured service and print normalized JSON.

internalTools.name: process-item
internalTools.purpose: Step 2: Process an item and write local evidence.

environmentVariables.name: EXAMPLE_SERVICE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional API token for the example service.

trackedAssets.purpose: Example optional environment variables without values.

generatedArtifacts.purpose: Archived local evidence, ignored by default.

hardBoundaries: Never commit credentials or local secret-bearing config.
Keep user-editable settings in settings.json as the single source of truth.
standardWorkflow: Preserve evidence and archive it after completion.
fallbackWorkflow: If a command cannot handle an edge case, update the command implementation rather than duplicating implementation details in AGENTS.md.
safetyRules: Command stdout is data for the agent; command stderr is diagnostics; command exit code indicates success/failure.
knownLimitations: This is a generic example; replace placeholder commands with your real implementation.

files.content:
# Optional token for the example service. Real values go in your shell environment or an untracked .env file.
EXAMPLE_SERVICE_TOKEN=

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
SETTINGS="$ROOT/settings.json"
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then cat "$SETTINGS"; else node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); let v=data; for (const p of process.argv[2].split(".")) v=v[p]; console.log(typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : v);' "$SETTINGS" "$1"; fi
